title: Ramification of the moduli map for hyperplane sections of K3s and hypersurfaces
summary: Finiteness and injectivity of the moduli morphisms $μ_n\colon|nH|_{\rm{sm}}\to\mathcal{M}_{g_n}$ associated with linear systems on K3 surfaces are understood in many cases. In this paper we study their ramification. Existing vanishing and stability results already imply unramifiedness when the polarisation or the multiple is sufficiently positive, so our focus is on low-degree phenomena.
